segments.text: In this town, hearts float above your head. One for every person who truly loves you.
Our mayor has zero. The man who sweeps our streets has four hundred and twelve.
Nobody knew why. Until the night I followed him.
The mayor called Old Ben a cheater, and wanted him gone before the festival.
So at four AM, I followed Ben.
He fixed Mrs. Lee's broken window.
Left bread at the orphanage door.
Every night. For forty years. And he never told anyone.
At the festival, the mayor pointed at Ben.
Then Mrs. Lee stood up. Then the baker. Then the orphans. One by one, the whole town stood behind Ben.
And above the mayor's head, for the first time, one heart appeared. Ben's.
